messages:
marie: CI red on integ run — multiple tests failing against Hosted API (auth + streaming + tool-call). 401s in toolcall tests and a couple streaming auth flakes. Anyone seen this?

deploy-bot: Pipeline #6824 failed: integ-hosted (auth_stream_toolcall) — logs uploaded to CI artifacts.

sam: I'm starting a bisect. First suspect: PR that touched header normalization last night (PR #4256). @ivan any idea?

ivan: I only changed tool payload schema mapping, but I did notice a flaky auth test locally that passed when I bumped the token expiry in the harness. Not sure if related.

kira: Quick repro: `pytest tests/integration/test_toolcall.py::test_tool_auth_flow -k hosted -q` — I consistently hit 401. In the request logs the streaming upgrade is missing the Authorization header (it shows up as lowercase `authorization`). Our internal proxy strips unknown lowercase headers.

marie: ugh. that header case issue rings a bell. can someone try a CI rerun with USE_LEGACY_HEADER=1 env?

sam: /retest (kicking a rerun now)

ci-bot: Rerun queued by sam — job 6828 started.

ci-bot: Rerun complete — still failing. Attaching trace: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/6828/artifacts/trace.log

ivan: I ran a local bisect — it points at 4256 -> introduced a small header-normalization utility in the proxy. Rolling that back locally makes tests pass.

kira: Can paste the minimal failing log: 
```
GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: hosted-api.redwood.ai
authorization: Bearer eyJ...
Upgrade: websocket

-> proxy drops `authorization` header on upgrade, returns 401 to runtime test client
```

marie: If 4256 is the culprit, we should hotfix. @sam can you open a rollback or hotfix PR?

sam: Opening hotfix now. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4362 — reverts the header normalization and adds a test.

kira: Proposal: make the runtime more tolerant (accept both `Authorization` and `authorization`) as a short-term mitigation. I'll sketch a tiny patch in the test harness to ensure we preserve header case for streaming tests too.

sam: Good plan. Also adding a targeted unit test for header-case-insensitivity.

marie: Assigning to eng-infra to triage and validate proxy behaviour in staging. @oncall_bot please page eng-oncall if we don't see a green in 30m.

oncall_bot: Paging eng-oncall rotation. If you are the current oncall, please acknowledge.

ci-bot: Extra rerun triggered by hotfix PR 4362 — job 6834 started.

ci-bot: Job 6834 finished — integration suite: partial green, toolcall/streaming auth tests now pass in staging, one unrelated flaky rerank test still failing.

ivan: Verified that reverting 4256 fixes the proxy behavior for streaming upgrades. I'm preparing a small follow-up to reintroduce safe normalization with explicit allowlist.

kira: LGTM on the hotfix test, watching CI.

marie: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread open until the follow-up normalization is more defensive. Will update when infra confirms rollout to prod. :thumbsup:
